gloss: little by little; bit by bit; in small amounts

definitions.gloss: little by little; bit by bit; in small amounts
definitions.explanation: Doing something in very small, gradual increments. Often implies a careful, cautious, or stingy approach.

examples.japanese: ちょびちょび⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
⟦{貯金|ちょきん}→貯金：03497_chokin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ちょびちょび⟦{使|つか}っている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: I'm spending my savings little by little.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦ウイスキー→ウイスキー：00412_uisukii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ちょびちょび⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{味|あじ}わい→味わう：04405_ajiwau⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧、⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しんだ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: I enjoyed the evening, savoring the expensive whiskey bit by bit.

notes:
An onomatopoeic (gitaigo) adverb expressing very small, incremental actions. Often used for drinking, eating, or spending money in tiny amounts. Has a casual, slightly humorous tone.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ちょびちょび⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧: to sip in small amounts
- ちょびちょび⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧: to eat in tiny bites
- ちょびちょび⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use/spend little by little
- ちょびちょび⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: variant with particle ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ちびちび→ちびちび：05778_chibichibi⟧: sipping slowly — very similar, especially for drinking
- ⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧: gradually — more neutral, standard expression
- ⟦こつこつ→こつこつ：27085_kotsukotsu⟧: steadily — implies diligent, persistent effort
